prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone tactile mixed-media editorial illustration for the BODY of a Chinese cultural feature about Dongying reed weaving; not a website screenshot and not a replacement for the existing first-screen city background.

Primary request: Create ONE original horizontal art illustration that interprets reed weaving through sculptural fibre-and-paper relief. Make the medium, palette and composition visibly different from an airy Chinese ink landscape: richly tactile, close, geometric and warm, with no ink-wash landscape treatment. This is explicitly AI creative art, not a photograph of an actual craft object, a historical reconstruction, an exact regional technique demonstration, or any identifiable artisan's existing design.

Subject and visual construction: At the centre, an invented open loop of honey-coloured reed strips curls into a shallow woven hollow, as a compact sculptural knot or ring. Flat slender strips interlace with clear over-under crossings, small gaps, uneven hand-shaped edges and exposed fine fibres. One ribbon unfurls diagonally into layered cut-paper shapes suggesting river channels and estuary sandbars. This is a poetic material study, not a conventional basket catalogue, a room interior, a real museum exhibit or a copy of a particular work. Keep the reed-weaving identity dominant; do not add unrelated pottery, calligraphy tools, embroidery, jewellery or other crafts.

Style and medium: an original hand-assembled-looking sculptural paper-and-reed relief illustration, slightly oblique overhead view, dimensional cut edges, shallow cast shadows, visible torn-paper pulp, dry mineral pigment and lengthwise reed fibres. The image should openly read as designed mixed-media artwork, not documentary photography. Refined, contemporary cultural art with tactile imperfections; no named artist or existing artwork imitation. Not a glossy 3D product render, not plastic, not crochet, not a fabric tapestry.

Composition: ONE complete landscape 16:9 canvas, ideally around 1792 by 1008 native pixels if supported. A compact circular/looped focal structure near the canvas centre contrasts with a strong diagonal sweep of interlacing and flat colour planes. Avoid a horizontal water horizon, distant scenery or a scroll-like composition. Keep the complete essential woven loop in the central 35 percent of width and central 60 percent of height, with breathing room around it so a centred mobile crop can retain a clear subject. Side regions can contain broad simple material and colour fields. No border or safe-area diagram, no collage board or multiple panels.

Colour and lighting: warm terracotta, burnt coral and marigold-ochre planes with a disciplined deep estuary ultramarine blue contrast; natural honey-gold reeds stay distinct from the paper. Small pale aqua accents may evoke river-meets-sea colour, without drawing a factual map. Use more saturated, deeper colours than pale ink painting, with soft raking light revealing fibre and relief depth; matte mineral surfaces, not metallic gloss or neon gradients.

Text: NONE. No letters, Chinese characters, calligraphy, signatures, red seals, captions, logos, watermarks, labels or pseudo-writing.
Constraints: no people, hands, tourist buildings, birds, boats, mountains or invented historical scene. No named object's exact design, fake accreditation, museum tag, interface, browser, phone, buttons or typography. No mounted-artwork mockup. One uninterrupted original artwork only.
timePrecision: 原记录起止时间及偏移原样保留
